description: This file contains implementation of variable packing logic for GLSL shader variables, including functions for expanding variables, checking packing limits, and packing variables into limited vector slots according to GLSL specifications.

classes.name: VariablePacker
classes.description: Class responsible for checking if expanded shader variables fit within specified packing limits.

methods.name: ExpandVariable
methods.description: Expands struct variables into individual fields, handling nested arrays and structs.

methods.name: ExpandStructVariable
methods.description: Expands a struct variable into its individual fields.

methods.name: ExpandStructArrayVariable
methods.description: Recursively expands arrayed struct variables into individual elements.

methods.name: checkExpandedVariablesWithinPackingLimits
methods.description: Checks if expanded variables fit within the maximum vector limit according to packing rules.
